archetype: LUXURY & CINEMATIC ROYAL MIDNIGHT (Arabian Night Garden)
emotional_tone: Majestic, celestial, spiritually uplifting, cinematic, intimate luxury

entry_surfaces./: Royal Star-tile Arch Gate with Carved Latticework & Luminescent Gold Seal — doors-open cinematic split reveal into moonlit garden

typesetting_rules: H1 (Hero): clamp(42px, 6.5vw, 60px) with leading-[0.95] and tracking-tight
Arabic script: font-arabic leading-relaxed text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-gold-glow
Overlines / Eyebrows: uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-xs font-semibold
NO text overlap with decorative arches, star tiles, lanterns or background figures — clean vertical flow with explicit margins and padding

layout_and_composition.philosophy: Cinematic Royal Midnight Arabian Night Garden — layers of depth with stars, moonlit arches, glowing brass lanterns, floral water canal, and geometric Islamic star tiles

doors_open_transition.concept: Majlis Star Arch Gate with dual-folding filigree doors opening outward upon tapping the luminous gold wax seal
doors_open_transition.animation: Left door rotatesY(-110deg), Right door rotatesY(110deg), wax seal pulses with gold particle burst, camera dollys smoothly into the moonlit midnight garden

layout_and_composition.grid_structure: Tetris & Bento Asymmetry — Single column on mobile (max-width 540px), balanced double-column / bento cards on desktop (max-width 1080px)
layering_z_index: z-0: Ambient starfield, nebula gradient, moon & garden silhouette canvas
z-10: Atmospheric mist, slow-swaying hanging lanterns, floating gold dust & rose petals
z-20: Decorative Islamic arch frames & card borders with 1px gold foil stroke
z-30: Pure legible text content, countdown timers, and interactive action buttons
z-40: Sticky topbar / audio player floating pill
z-50: Fullscreen opening screen and transition overlay

motifs: 8-point Islamic Star Tile (Girih / Khatam pattern) debossed in gold foil lines
Hanging Moroccan / Arabian brass lanterns with warm golden flame flicker
Rippling moonlit palace garden canal with floating glowing lotus & rose petals (no creatures/animals/people)
Film grain overlay (CSS SVG noise filter) for cinematic analog warmth
Slow parallax camera drift on scroll
strict_visual_rules: ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, ANIMALS, BIRDS, OR INSECTS in any image, illustration, SVG or animation
Every text block MUST sit in its own dedicated clear row — NO overlapping text on static symbols or geometric ornaments
Nikah Time is explicitly marked at 11:30 AM (gathering begins 11:30 AM), Reception at 1:00 PM, Lunch after Zuhr
Countdown timer strictly targets 02 January 2027, 11:00 AM IST (2027-01-02T11:00:00+05:30)
All wedding config data (names, dates, times, map link, calendar links, Qur'an quote) stored in a clean config structure or top-level constants

nasheed_audio.behavior: Autoplays upon guest tapping the glowing wax seal on the gate; sound toggle button in topbar/floating dock allows instant mute/unmute

calendar_integration.logic: Auto-detects iOS/macOS devices to download .ics; opens Google Calendar for Android/Windows/others

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: IntersectionObserver staggered fades with subtle translateY(24px) to (0px) and soft gold luminescence

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the existing pink/maroon theme in index.html and styles.css with the cinematic 'Royal Midnight – Arabian Night Garden' color scheme (Midnight Indigo #0B0C1A, Deep Violet #120E26, Royal Gold #E5AE33, Rose #E27B88, Turquoise #2DD4BF, Saffron #F59E0B).
2. Ensure the Doors-Open transition is smooth: when clicking the wax seal #open-invitation, animate the arch doors opening with perspective and play the nasheed audio (assets/al-hamdulillah.mp3).
3. UPDATE Nikah time in HTML and JS to 11:30 AM (as requested: 'Mark Nikah Time at 11.30 AM instead of 10.30').
4. UPDATE Countdown target in script.js to '2027-01-02T11:00:00+05:30' (11:00 AM IST on 2 Jan 2027).
5. ABSOLUTELY NO figures of people, animals, birds or insects anywhere in CSS, SVG, or images.
6. Ensure clean alignment: every text line has its own row, nothing overlaps with decorative figures or background arches.

7. Include comprehensive data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='open-invitation-btn', data-testid='music-toggle-btn', data-testid='add-to-calendar-btn', data-testid='map-location-link', data-testid='countdown-days').
8. Keep responsive mobile-first padding and floating bottom navigation dock for smooth navigation on phones.
